note: The valley has no paving and no plaza, so nothing about where its ground opens or closes can be derived from the map — the route, the pond shore and the hunting ground in the north-east are all authored here. Regions are paint, in file order; tiles no region covers keep the seeded variation.

regions.note: The lane from the village gate to the far south: kept clear for its whole length so the valley reads as a route rather than a field, and so nothing stands between a courier and the way home.
Arrival meadow at the gate, where the welcome sign and the blue banner are.
Mossy Pond shore: open enough that the water is visible from the lane, with the shore props (stump, rocks, bush) framing it.
Blueberry patch: open ground for the flower beds and the sign, so the patch reads as tended rather than wild.
North-east hunting ground, against the tree belt. The thickest cover in the valley, and where the deer and grouse spawn.
South-west copse, closing the corner opposite the hunting ground so the far end of the lane has trees on both sides.

entrances.note: The gate from Clover Village. Framed wider than the village's own mouths because it is the only way in, and the first thing a courier sees of the valley.
